Chapter 905: Chapter 9: Hope (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 905: Chapter 9: Hope (Please Subscribe)

The black wooden box appears to be just a wooden box on the surface, containing three portions of Immortal Essence.

But in fact, it is made up of layers of sealing techniques.

Completely isolating the inside and outside of the box, including space and causality.

Only thus can the dispersion of ‘Immortal Essence’ be minimized as much as possible.

In terms of value, not to mention the Immortal Essence within the wooden box, just the box itself…

Is worth no less than one hundred thousand top-grade Immortal Crystals, equivalent to the entire fortune of a common Jade Immortal.

Buzz.

Inside the black wooden box.

There lies a fist-sized crystal with points of light circulating inside, resembling endless stars.

As the seal on the wooden box is opened, the crystal begins to emit strands of aura, spreading in all directions, faintly enveloping Lin Yuan in a mysterious universe.

And within this universe—

The fluctuations of many great rules ripple towards him like waves.

“This…”

Lin Yuan’s mind is shaken, the experience he is undergoing is like a person who has been thirsty for dozens of days suddenly plunging into water, the longed-for source of water rushing endlessly towards him.

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding, observing the mysterious Origin Source, boosts your comprehension of various fundamental rules…]

In almost an instant, Lin Yuan immerses himself in cultivation, the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, among many other Pillar-level Fusion Rules, visibly accelerating.

Half a day later.

Lin Yuan looks at the ‘Immortal Essence’ in front of him, now reduced in size, and quickly closes the wooden box.

Instantly, the inside and outside of the wooden box are isolated, stopping the dispersion of the Immortal Essence’s aura, and everything returns to normal.

“This Immortal Essence, coming from the Origin of the Immortal Realm, is condensed from the auras of the Primordial Lands, once it arrives in the outside world, losing the condensing environment, the Immortal Essence will ‘evaporate’, ‘disperse’.”

“And the aura of the Immortal Realm’s Origin Source dispersed by the evaporation briefly replicates the environment of the Origin of the Immortal Realm…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes sparkle.

Just like water turns into ice in a subzero environment.

But as soon as it returns to above zero, the ice turns back into water again.

The Immortal Essence works on a similar principle.

Simply put, just now, Lin Yuan, in effect, briefly cultivated at the Origin of the Immortal Realm.

The feeling of the great principles raining down aids Lin Yuan far more than when other Jade Immortals ponder the Immortal Essence.

After all, Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding gives him a cultivation speed that far surpasses other Jade Immortals.

The same apple hitting on the head, some people only feel the apple is really hard, or that it’s not tasty.

But others can directly understand some fundamental nature of the universe, this is the difference in understanding.

The brief environment formed by the dispersal of Immortal Essence gives Lin Yuan incredible gains.

Just in that short half-day, Lin Yuan feels he has advanced further in understanding the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, and so it is with the other Pillar-level Fusion Rules.

If it was just accelerating the understanding of rules, it wouldn’t have shaken Lin Yuan so much.

After all, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, even without the Immortal Essence, he would eventually comprehend what needs to be comprehended, just taking more time.

However.

Through just that brief comprehension of the Immortal Essence, Lin Yuan, including the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, has all rules progressing simultaneously, feeling like all the myriad principles unify into one, akin to Chaos?

“Chaos Rule?”

Lin Yuan’s spirit soars.

So far, Lin Yuan hasn’t been sure about comprehending the Chaos Rule at Level 11, as there’s no direction given, even Xuanhuang and the Demonic Jade Tower Master can provide no guidance.

What Lin Yuan can do is to understand as many great principles as possible.

But just now, Lin Yuan finally sensed the feeling of everything returning to chaos.

“Immortal Essence, Immortal Essence can help me comprehend the Chaos Rule.”

Lin Yuan thinks to himself, comprehending the Chaos Rule at Level 11, not only massively boosts his strength, but also greatly enhances the probability when reaching the ultimate phase.

Compared to the former, Lin Yuan values the latter more.

…

“Unfortunately, the Immortal Essence is consumed too quickly.”

Lin Yuan looks at the wooden box in front of him, it has shrunk after being opened just for a short half-day.

If he keeps comprehending without restraint, probably in just over ten days, the three portions of Immortal Essence would be completely dissipated.

“No wonder the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall told me to open the wooden box only when I’m comprehending in cultivation,” Lin Yuan muses to himself.

Even if it’s just opened briefly, the consumption of Immortal Essence would reach one in a hundred thousand, one in ten million, which is a definite loss.

“The following cultivation, only at critical moments can I rely on Immortal Essence, other times, it’s normal comprehension.”

Lin Yuan looks up at the irregular cracks in the sky.

“Additionally, try to obtain more Immortal Essence.”

If there is ample Immortal Essence, Lin Yuan’s cultivation speed would definitely surpass the current, and comprehending the Chaos Rule would no longer be a mere wish.

…

“Does Heavenly Water Holy Palace also want the master to concoct a batch of Nine Revolutions Golden Pills? They’re only willing to offer twenty million top-grade Immortal Crystals?”

“Too stingy, just refuse them.”

“Cangliu Palace wants the master to concoct a Life and Death Reincarnation Pill, offering thirty million top-grade Immortal Crystals as the reward?”

“The Life and Death Reincarnation Pill is even rarer than the Nine Revolutions Golden Pill; the Alchemy Master would also need to undergo life and death risks to concoct it, just thirty million top-grade Immortal Crystals? I don’t even feel like refusing.”

“Sun Moon Sect is willing to offer one portion of Immortal Essence, asking the master to start the furnace once…this could be considered, the master said, those involving Immortal Essence, shouldn’t be so easily refused…”

…

Inside the Great Hall, Yun Zhenzi looks at the letters from various forces, quickly glancing through, rejecting all those without sincerity.

Ever since Lin Yuan successfully concocted the first batch of Nine Revolutions Golden Pills, inciting the descent of heavenly tribulation, and eventually the successful formation of pills, his reputation as the topmost Alchemy Master has truly spread widely.
